The Sacred Flower

Grey Leaf, leader of the Green Clan, may help find the knight Brissen. Steal the Sacred Flower from the White Clan foresters to summon Grey Leaf for talks.

Objectives

Go to the White Clan's territory

Obtain an evergreen leaf

Switch off the trap

Collect the flower

Locations

Maps
City outskirts
